runs.seed_policy: Single checkpoint: run 3 (20261111-210302), best pass 33; inference has no randomness
runs.preprocessing: RGB; both screenshots padded white at the bottom and right to the larger size; predicted on 192 px squares around differing pixels (INPUT_MODE diff_squares)
runs.box_rule: Box around all pixels with regression confidence > 0.5; point at the most confident pixel; none if nothing is flagged

kimi.api: OpenRouter moonshotai/kimi-k2.5, provider amazon-bedrock, no fallbacks
kimi.no_box_rule: Pairs without a detector box are answered reject with the no-difference text; Kimi is not called
